mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates and supports valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5 percentage points signals severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.5% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through joint series behavior.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >40% of cases (or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contracting below 100 (2017=100) reflects manufacturing weakness that depresses corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 (or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent price pressures that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts signal immediate demand strength in residential construction that boosts consumer confidence and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST is rising (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) create a supportive environment for equity valuations through reduced discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 145,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where PAYEMS > 145000 (or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).
